definition: An unsanctioned, unanaesthetized biotech or geneware modification performed without medical oversight, typically in a back-alley clinic or squat lab. Carries high infection risk and legal liability, but is the only accessible option for Tier 1 residents who cannot afford licensed procedures.
origin: Medical/street hybrid slang; 'cold' refers to the absence of sanctioned anesthesia protocols
usage: Shelf and low-tier Old Harbor communities; used matter-of-factly by those who have had them and with alarm by those who haven't
example: The graft was taking, but ragged at the edges — cold splice work, no question, done by someone with steady hands and no license.
